statements.tableau_correctness_iff: ∀ (M : PolyNTMCandidate) (x : BitString) (t : ℕ), SATLanguage (boundedExecCircuit_NTM M x t) ↔ M.machine.AcceptsWithin t (initialNTMConfig M.machine x)
statements.boundedExec_encoded_length_poly: ∀ M x t, (encodeCircuit (boundedExecCircuit_NTM M x t)).length ≤ tableauEncodingCoeff M * (x.length + t + 1)^4

what_is_missing_for_PneqNP_to_G21: a deterministic poly-time machine (in the repository model) that computes x ↦ encodeCircuit (boundedExecCircuit_NTM M x (T |x|))
composition of that machine with a hypothetical SAT decider (PolyDTMCandidate) giving a decider for an arbitrary NP language
